meta.name: cloud-iam-deep
meta.description: Cloud IAM red-team attack chain across AWS, Azure, GCP — focused on EXTERNAL exploitation paths and post-credential-discovery privilege analysis. Covers IAM enumeration (aws iam, az role, gcloud iam), STS/AssumeRole chaining, Azure Managed Identity abuse (via SSRF/leak), GCP service account JSON abuse, IMDSv1/v2 attacks via SSRF, K8s ServiceAccount token privilege analysis once held (token discovery / cluster exposure is owned by hunt-k8s), role-trust-policy confused-deputy, cross-account assume-role enumeration, IAM privilege escalation patterns (24+ AWS, 8+ Azure, 6+ GCP), and AWS Cognito Identity Pool unauthenticated-role attack chain (GetId → GetCredentialsForIdentity → IAM role abuse). Built for the case where recon yields a credential (key, JSON, token) and you need to know what it grants and how to escalate. Use when an AWS key / Azure secret / GCP service account JSON / K8s SA token surfaces from a code repo, JS bundle, APK, breach corpus, or SSRF chain.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你分析云平台（AWS、Azure、GCP）的 IAM 权限，发现提权路径，比如从泄露的密钥或令牌出发，模拟攻击链。
howto.when: 当你拿到一个云凭证（如 AWS 密钥、Azure 客户端密码、GCP 服务账号 JSON 或 K8s 令牌）时触发。

say.text: 我找到了一个 AWS 访问密钥，帮我看看它能做什么。
这个 GCP 服务账号 JSON 文件有什么权限？
say.note: Claude 会激活账号并列出角色。

say.text: 我有个 Azure 客户端密码，帮我检查它能访问哪些资源。
say.note: Claude 会登录并列出订阅和角色分配。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you analyze IAM permissions across AWS, Azure, and GCP, identify privilege escalation paths, and simulate attack chains starting from leaked credentials or tokens.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you obtain a cloud credential such as an AWS key, Azure client secret, GCP service account JSON, or Kubernetes token.

say_en.text: I found an AWS access key. Can you check what it can do?
say_en.note: Claude will run sts get-caller-identity and other commands.

say_en.text: What permissions does this GCP service account JSON have?
say_en.note: Claude will activate the account and list roles.

say_en.text: I have an Azure client secret. Can you check which resources it can access?
say_en.note: Claude will log in and list subscriptions and role assignments.
